text.p: The Polish construction company Mostostal Zabrze SA's large investor tranche of 2.0 million shares was oversubscribed while the small investor tranche of 600,000 was undersubscribed, the firm said in a statement.
It said investors subscribed for a total of 3,458,815 shares of the 2.6 million share issue.

It said investors subscribed for 3,216,010 shares in the large investor tranche. In the small investor tranche 242,805 shares were subscribed and the firm had transferred the remaining shares to the large investor tranche.
It said in the large tranche 17 preferred investors took the shares with their orders scaled down 12.4 percent.
It earlier said the preferred investors were those, who took part in the book-building process and were holding Mostostal's shares before the issue.
